scope: Q4_K SM86 child-CTA row/column ownership and integer MMA input mapping
per-output FP32 accumulation order and Q4_K/Q8_1 scale application
logical stream-K partitioning, direct output, and scratch/fixup layout
default-off dispatch and test fixture/oracle coverage

evidence.basis: The child CTA offset is blockIdx.y*64; launch uses two y CTAs while retaining the x stream-K partition count. Logical stream-K coordinates are decoded from blockIdx.x, so blockIdx.y does not replace the logical stream-K row or column coordinate. Q4 loading adds the child row displacement using the source row stride. Child results use disjoint row intervals [0,64) and [64,128); fixup writes use the original logical I=128 scratch stride and logical row index. Direct stores use local child rows plus the same child offset in the destination base.

For each warp, threadIdx.y/4 selects one of two 32-row groups and threadIdx.y%4 selects one of four 8-column banks. Two 16-row MMA tiles cover each 32-row group. The four 32-column j0 chunks and bank offset cover the 128 output columns without overlap. Each thread's slot is indexed by j0 chunk, row tile, and native tile_C element. Q4 scale pairs and Q8_1 scale pairs are loaded per same output/K slice; FP32 updates retain the native ordered pair of += operations. K slices are visited in increasing order for each output.

The override changes the Q4 tile row extent to 64 and uses that extent when calculating packed Q4 staging sizes and row loops; the call site advances the raw source block index by the child row stride.

The child regression uses the pinned 17408-row and 384-row Q4_K K=5120 fixture paths at T=1280 and T=1281, writes full BF16 output dumps, retains the existing baseline comparison, and adds a scalar Q8_1-represented Q4_K oracle for sampled outputs.
The feature option defaults OFF and compilation is gated to CUDA architecture 86. Runtime launch is further gated on Q4_K/J=128, CC 86, no ids_dst, and no async X/Y staging.

limits: No compile, test, GPU, sanitizer, SASS, or performance run was performed.
Static inspection does not prove compiler-generated fragment mapping or runtime byte parity; preserve the manifest's exact-output, independent-oracle, eager/graph, and resource gates.
Reviewed only the pinned isolated prototype; it is not integrated and no speedup is claimed.
